item.title: Warmer conditions on the way, snow will be melting
item.description: We started the week off Monday with highs near 30° and there's warmer air coming in our current 10 Day Forecast. For early morning, temperatures fall to the mid-20s and then rise toward daybreak. Temperatures at sunrise will be in the 30s. A warm front moves north on Tuesday, allowing warmer air to blow in [...]

item.title: Indiana expands options for blackout license plate
item.description: Since its debut last year, the Indiana Bureau of Motor Vehicles (BMV) blackout license plate has been hugely popular.

item.title: Seahawks ride their 'Dark Side' defense to a Super Bowl title, pounding the Patriots 29-13
item.description: Tom Brady once led Bill Belichick’s Patriots to the greatest comeback in Super Bowl history, when New England rallied from a 28-3 deficit against Atlanta for a 34-28 overtime victory.

item.title: Plant shop owner grows and heals at same time
item.description: In this week's Positively Fort Wayne, WANE 15's Pat Hoffmann catches up with Jessica Fuller, the owner of Fuller Plants LLC. In part one of a two-part series, Fuller sheds light about how caring for plants can be a form of mental health therapy that can benefit everyone. She opened the plant shop four years [...]

item.title: First updates to 'All in Allen Plan' go before Fort Wayne Plan Commission
item.description: The plan acts as a blueprint to guide growth and development.

item.title: Fort Wayne 'Street Chef' Eddie Ribel dies at 55
item.description: Fort Wayne Police found Ribel Sunday morning in his bus after a friend called for a wellness check when Ribel didn't return calls or texts on Saturday.

item.title: Local bike shop owner plans new homeless service center
item.description: The owner of Allen County's 469 Cycle Shop fashions himself as "the smartest hillbilly you ever met." But beyond that, he has a passion for Fort Wayne's homeless population.

item.title: SAM scholarship remembers Norwell alum, honoring service and motivation
item.description: After Sam Peterson's unexpected death last summer, his loved ones find special meaning at Norwell. Sam's legacy lives in the digital pictures which flash his 100-yard Butterfly record and on the Norwell Military Wall of Honor.

item.description: Fort Wayne Fire Department crews were called to the 9300 block of South Anthony around 8:30 p.m. Monday, according to Fort Wayne dispatch.
